{{Top|leg}}
A '''containment unit''', often referred to as an '''irradiator box''', was used to sterilize equipment. Used aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]], items were placed in the unit and cleaned using a combination of broad-spectrum [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], ultrasonics, and other methods to neutralize [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]], [[virus]]es, and contagions. [[Synthtech Medtech Corporation]] made two containment units; the smaller [[Irradiator Box]] and the larger [[Irradiator Booth]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref> Containment units were portable versions of [[irradiator]]s. They were most often used by exploratory crews; [[Captain/Legends|captains]] made sure anything brought back from a foreign [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was placed in an irradiation box to protect from potentially dangerous viruses and bacteria.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|116}}</ref>
